title: Add --compact flag to claude-trail for 3-line terminal glance output
essence: Before this change, the only way to view a cycle's verdict and cost was the full markdown trail (dozens of lines). After this change, `claude-trail <id> --compact` emits exactly 3 lines — title, verdict, cost — enabling fast terminal-glance checks. The flag is mutually exclusive with --format json, --out, and --since, each rejected with a clear error message.

checkpoints.label: rationale
checkpoints.caption: What a reviewer should grep to convince themselves --compact works
checkpoints.afterNote:
1. `grep -n 'renderCompact' src/trail.ts` → line 121: exports a 3-line function returning `# Trail — <id>
Verdict: <v>
Cost: $<n.toFixed(2)>
`. 2. `grep -n 'compactFlag' src/cli.ts` → lines 305–326 parse `--compact`, validate mutual exclusions (--format json / --out / --since each exit non-zero with a descriptive message), then line 460 calls `renderCompact(initiativeId, verdict, costUsd)`. 3. `cat tests/fixtures/INIT-FIXTURE-1.trail-compact.golden.md` → matches the 3-line spec exactly. 4. `npm test` → 246 pass, 0 fail — compact-flag.test.ts (AC1–AC4) and compact-smoke.test.ts both in the green suite.
